findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a worker asks which command-line flag to use, and the answering round with `--strict` is interrupted.
A valid invocation using `--note=--strict` produces the retry `forge work <item> --note --strict`. `repo.quote` in src/forge/repo.py:397-400 leaves that token unchanged, and argparse treats it as an option rather than the note's value. The retry therefore refuses because `--note` has no argument, so the required answer still cannot be replayed for flag-valued answers.
findings.title: Functional: Include the required answer in the retry instruction

why: A forge work run cut short by a shell time limit leaves its lock and its builder turn unfinished and says nothing, so the lost round shows only later.
